description: This file implements the ResourceManager plugin for a media or device management system, providing methods for controlling AV blocking, TTS resource reservation, and interacting with external components via JSON-RPC. It includes class definitions, method implementations, and external API calls.

classes.name: ResourceManager
classes.description: Main class implementing the resource management plugin, handling AV blocking, TTS resource reservation, and JSON-RPC communication.

classes.name: JSONRPCDirectLink
classes.description: Helper class for making direct JSON-RPC calls to other services.

methods.name: setAVBlockedWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to set AV blocking status for an application.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplicationsWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to retrieve list of applications with AV blocked.

methods.name: reserveTTSResourceWrapperForApps
methods.description: Wrapper method to reserve TTS resources for multiple applications.

methods.name: reserveTTSResourceWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to reserve TTS resource for a single application.

methods.name: setAVBlocked
methods.description: Sets the AV blocked status for a given callsign.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplications
methods.description: Retrieves the list of applications currently blocked from AV.

methods.name: reserveTTSResource
methods.description: Reserves TTS resource for a specific client.

methods.name: reserveTTSResourceForApps
methods.description: Reserves TTS resources for a list of applications.
